mapper.sql: p.status = 'WAIT_CALLBACK' AND NULLIF(TRIM(p.channel_transaction_no), '') IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_payment_attempt latest_attempt WHERE latest_attempt.id = ( SELECT attempt.id FROM t_payment_attempt attempt WHERE attempt.payment_order_id = p.payment_order_id AND CHAR_LENGTH(attempt.payment_order_id) = CHAR_LENGTH(p.payment_order_id) AND CAST(attempt.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(p.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) ORDER BY attempt.created_at DESC, attempt.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AND latest_attempt.attempt_status = '渠道提交中')
mapper.select: SELECT payment_summary.total_count AS totalCount, payment_summary.success_count AS successCount, CONCAT(FORMAT(ROUND(payment_summary.success_rate, 2), 2), '%') AS successRate, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(payment_summary.success_amount, 2)) AS successAmount, payment_summary.pending_payment_count AS pendingPaymentCount, payment_summary.closed_payment_count AS closedPaymentCount, COALESCE(refund_summary.failed_refund_count, 0) AS failedRefundCount, COALESCE(refund_summary.processing_refund_count, 0) AS processingRefundCount, COALESCE(channel_summary.disabled_channel_count, 0) AS disabledChannelCount, ( CASE WHEN payment_summary.wait_callback_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN payment_summary.unaccepted_submit_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN payment_summary.missing_success_time_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN payment_success_fact_summary.mismatch_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN COALESCE(refund_summary.missing_success_time_count, 0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN refund_terminal_summary.mismatch_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN COALESCE(refund_summary.failed_refund_count, 0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN COALESCE(channel_summary.disabled_channel_count, 0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS alertCount FROM ( SELECT COUNT(1) AS total_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS success_count, CASE WHEN COUNT(1) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(1) END AS success_rate, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS success_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('PREPAY_CREATED', 'WAIT_CALLBACK') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_payment_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'WAIT_CALLBACK' AND NOT () THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS wait_callback_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unaccepted_submit_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' AND success_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS missing_success_time_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'CLOSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS closed_payment_count FROM t_payment_order p ) payment_summary CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(1) AS mismatch_count FROM t_payment_order p WHERE ) payment_success_fact_summary CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'FAIL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failed_refund_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PROCESSING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS processing_refund_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' AND success_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS missing_success_time_count FROM t_refund_order ) refund_summary CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(1) AS mismatch_count FROM t_refund_order refund_order WHERE ) refund_terminal_summary CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(1) AS disabled_channel_count FROM t_payment_channel_config WHERE status = 'DISABLED' ) channel_summary

SELECT daily_fact.stat_date AS statDate, SUM(daily_fact.total_count) AS totalCount, SUM(daily_fact.success_count) AS successCount, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(COALESCE(SUM(daily_fact.success_amount), 0), 2)) AS successAmount FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS stat_date, COUNT(1) AS total_count, 0 AS success_count, 0 AS success_amount FROM t_payment_order WHERE created_at >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL '6' DAY AND created_at < CURDATE() + INTERVAL '1' DAY GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d')
UNION ALL
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(success_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS stat_date, 0 AS total_count, COUNT(1) AS success_count, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS success_amount FROM t_payment_order p WHERE AND success_at >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL '6' DAY AND success_at < CURDATE() + INTERVAL '1' DAY GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(success_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ) daily_fact GROUP BY daily_fact.stat_date ORDER BY statDate DESC LIMIT 7
mapper.sql: SELECT channel_code AS channelCode, payment_method AS paymentMethod, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN trusted_success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successCount, CONCAT( FORMAT(ROUND( CASE WHEN COUNT(1) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN trusted_success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(1) END, 2), 2 ), '%' ) AS successRate, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN trusted_success = 1 THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0), 2)) AS successAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'WAIT_CALLBACK' AND unaccepted_submit = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingCount, SUM(unaccepted_submit) AS unacceptedCount, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'WAIT_CALLBACK' AND unaccepted_submit = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'P1' WHEN SUM(unaccepted_submit) > 0 THEN 'P2' WHEN ( CASE WHEN COUNT(1) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN trusted_success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(1) END ) < 80 THEN 'P2' ELSE '正常' END AS riskLevel, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'WAIT_CALLBACK' AND unaccepted_submit = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'danger' WHEN SUM(unaccepted_submit) > 0 THEN 'warn' WHEN ( CASE WHEN COUNT(1) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN trusted_success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(1) END ) < 80 THEN 'warn' ELSE 'success' END AS riskLevelType, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'WAIT_CALLBACK' AND unaccepted_submit = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN '存在待收口支付单，建议优先查单并核对回调。' WHEN SUM(unaccepted_submit) > 0 THEN '渠道受理未确认，先核对渠道受理结果，勿主动查单或重复提交。' WHEN ( CASE WHEN COUNT(1) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN trusted_success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(1) END ) < 80 THEN '成功率偏低，建议检查路由命中、渠道稳定性和异常日志。' ELSE '当前渠道表现稳定，可持续观察。' END AS riskHint FROM (SELECT p.*, CASE WHEN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS trusted_success, CASE WHEN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS unaccepted_submit FROM t_payment_order p) payment_facts WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_payment_attempt WHERE t_payment_attempt.payment_order_id = payment_facts.payment_order_id ) GROUP BY channel_code, payment_method ORDER BY totalCount DESC, successCount DESC, channel_code ASC, payment_method ASC
mapper.select:
SELECT 1 AS alertSortNo, 'WAIT_CALLBACK_TIMEOUT' AS alertType, '支付回调待收口' AS alertTitle, '仍有支付单处于待回调状态，需要主动查单或补回调。' AS alertMessage, 'P1' AS alertLevel, 'danger' AS alertLevelType, COUNT(1) AS affectedCount, '进入支付交易异常中心，优先核对待回调支付单、回调日志和查单结果。' AS suggestedAction, '/payment-issues?issueType=待回调未收口' AS actionRoute FROM t_payment_order p WHERE p.status = 'WAIT_CALLBACK' AND NOT () HAVING COUNT(1) > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 2 AS alertSortNo, 'CHANNEL_SUBMIT_UNCONFIRMED' AS alertType, '渠道提交受理未确认' AS alertTitle, '支付单处于渠道提交窗口，尚无渠道受理流水，需要核对提交结果。' AS alertMessage, 'P2' AS alertLevel, 'warn' AS alertLevelType, COUNT(1) AS affectedCount, '核对渠道受理结果与提交日志，等待状态推进，勿主动查单或重复提交。' AS suggestedAction, '/payments?status=WAIT_CALLBACK' AS actionRoute FROM t_payment_order p WHERE HAVING COUNT(1) > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 3 AS alertSortNo, 'PAYMENT_SUCCESS_TIME_MISSING' AS alertType, '支付成功时间缺失' AS alertTitle, '存在已成功但缺少成功时间的支付单，无法可信归属支付账期。' AS alertMessage, 'P1' AS alertLevel, 'danger' AS alertLevelType, COUNT(1) AS affectedCount, '进入支付单管理页核对成功时间缺失记录。' AS suggestedAction, '/payments?status=SUCCESS_TIME_MISSING' AS actionRoute FROM t_payment_order WHERE status = 'SUCCESS' AND success_at IS NULL HAVING COUNT(1) > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 4 AS alertSortNo, 'PAYMENT_SUCCESS_FACT_MISMATCH' AS alertType, '支付成功事实不一致' AS alertTitle, '支付终态与渠道尝试、预付绑定或订单来源不一致，需核查原始事实。' AS alertMessage, 'P1' AS alertLevel, 'danger' AS alertLevelType, COUNT(1) AS affectedCount, '按支付单号核对预付单、订单来源、最新尝试、渠道流水和操作日志，不得自动补标。' AS suggestedAction, '/payments?status=SUCCESS_FACT_MISMATCH' AS actionRoute FROM t_payment_order p WHERE HAVING COUNT(1) > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 5 AS alertSortNo, 'REFUND_SUCCESS_TIME_MISSING' AS alertType, '退款成功时间缺失' AS alertTitle, '存在已成功但缺少成功时间的退款单，无法可信归属逆向资金账期。' AS alertMessage, 'P1' AS alertLevel, 'danger' AS alertLevelType, COUNT(1) AS affectedCount, '进入退款单管理页核对成功时间缺失记录。' AS suggestedAction, '/refunds?refundStatus=SUCCESS_TIME_MISSING' AS actionRoute FROM t_refund_order WHERE status = 'SUCCESS' AND success_at IS NULL HAVING COUNT(1) > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 6 AS alertSortNo, 'REFUND_TERMINAL_FACT_MISMATCH' AS alertType, '退款终态事实不一致' AS alertTitle, '存在退款单终态与最新退款尝试状态不一致或完成事实缺失的记录。' AS alertMessage, 'P1' AS alertLevel, 'danger' AS alertLevelType, COUNT(1) AS affectedCount, '进入退款单管理页核对退款单、最新尝试和操作日志。' AS suggestedAction, '/refunds?refundStatus=TERMINAL_FACT_MISMATCH' AS actionRoute FROM t_refund_order refund_order WHERE HAVING COUNT(1) > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 7 AS alertSortNo, 'REFUND_FAIL' AS alertType, '退款失败待重试' AS alertTitle, '退款单存在失败记录，需要运营复核后重试或切线下处理。' AS alertMessage, 'P1' AS alertLevel, 'danger' AS alertLevelType, COUNT(1) AS affectedCount, '进入退款单管理页，按失败状态过滤后复核重试。' AS suggestedAction, '/refunds?refundStatus=FAIL' AS actionRoute FROM t_refund_order WHERE status = 'FAIL' HAVING COUNT(1) > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 8 AS alertSortNo, 'CHANNEL_DISABLED' AS alertType, '渠道已停用' AS alertTitle, '存在已停用渠道，请确认是否需要同步调整路由规则。' AS alertMessage, 'P2' AS alertLevel, 'warn' AS alertLevelType, COUNT(1) AS affectedCount, '进入支付渠道与路由页，检查停用渠道和对应路由规则。' AS suggestedAction, '/payment-config?channelStatus=DISABLED' AS actionRoute FROM t_payment_channel_config WHERE status = 'DISABLED' HAVING COUNT(1) > 0 ORDER BY alertSortNo ASC
